name: RunLine
summary:
RunLine. Train smarter, run faster.

RunLine turns your Meta Quest into a portable agility course visualization and training tool. Step inside a course and experience the complete layout at a true 1:1 scale before setting up a single obstacle.

Visualize courses created in SmarterAgility directly in mixed reality. RunLine recreates the full layout based on the original course design, allowing you to explore it exactly as planned.

Every standard obstacle is represented with precise geometry:
